ha-poc.title: Two homes, one shared view
ha-poc.subtitle: Active at home. A replica for the other.
ha-poc.notice: Replay of both HA structures — simulated commands and failures
ha-poc.notice_detail: Descriptions come from two anonymised exports. No live physical state and no real commands.
ha-poc.matrix_hint: One role per home: both servers can be active at once, each for its own home.
ha-poc.waiting: Apply a configuration to start the bench.
ha-poc.settings_hint: Choose a layout, inspect its draft matrix, then start the simulation.
ha-poc.draft_hint: 16 KiB maximum. Fictional IDs only, no addresses or secrets. The bench performs final validation.
ha-poc.invalid: Invalid layout: check the JSON IDs, references, fields and limits.
ha-poc.error: Action rejected or service unavailable. Your draft is preserved.
ha-poc.promotion_hint: A remote replica only takes over cloud scope, on human request. No radio or local network capability is transferred.
ha-poc.node_hint: These buttons only control the bench processes and simulated links.
ha-poc.limits: What this bench does not prove
ha-poc.limits_detail: Local processes do not prove two real sites, a VPN, distributed quorum or clock qualification. The central witness is for simulation only. State and configuration stay in memory for this session.
ha-poc.draft_invalid: Preview unavailable: the JSON draft is invalid.
